_comment: Community-submitted base designs. Each entry is one player's build. Add a design by pasting the share code from the planner. Votes are NOT stored here - they live in the vote service (see worker/), and the site fetches them at page load.
voteApiNote: Base URL of the deployed vote worker, e.g. https://votes.wardogsbuilder.workers.dev. While this is empty the site shows scores as unavailable rather than faking them.
